mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM ts_agent_chat_message m INNER JOIN ts_agent_chat_session s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE m.id = #{id} AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.session_status != 'deleted' AND m.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(m.message_no), 0) + 1 FROM ts_agent_chat_message m WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} FOR UPDATE
